chapter.heading: A psalm of David. A song of praise.
chapter.v:
I will
glorify you, my God and King! I will praise who you are forever and ever!

I will
praise you every day; I will praise your character forever and ever!

The Lord
is great and deserves much praise! His greatness cannot be measured!

Let every
generation tell the next all that you do, sharing the stories of your amazing miracles!

They will
speak of your majesty, your glorious splendor, and I will meditate on the wonderful things you have done.

They will
speak of the power of your awesome actions, and I will say how wonderful you are.

They will
explain to everyone how famous you are for your tremendous goodness, and joyfully celebrate how you always do what is right.

The Lord
is gracious and merciful, not easily angered, and full of trustworthy love.

The Lord
is good to everyone, and he shows mercy to all his created beings.

All the
created beings will thank you, Lord, and all who faithfully follow you will praise you.

They will
praise the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power.

They will
explain to people your wonderful miracles, and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

Your kingdom
never ends, and your rule continues for all generations. What the Lord promises can always be trusted; he is merciful in all he does.

The Lord
helps up all those who fall down; he lifts up all those who are bowed down.

All eyes
are on you, waiting in hope, and you give food at just the right time.

You give
generously and satisfy the needs of every living thing.

The Lord
does right in everything—his actions are always trustworthy.

The Lord
is close to all who ask for his help, to all who ask in sincerity.

He satisfies
the needs of those who follow him. He hears their cries for help and he saves them.

The Lord
takes care of all those who love him, but he will destroy all those who are wicked.

I will
speak in praise of the Lord, and may everyone honor his holy character, forever and ever.
